source_attempted: PMC11310338 full text reviewed via WebFetch; methods describe virtual screening of a 1024-sequence ssDNA pool
rejection_reason: Not a traditional HT-SELEX experiment. The "Blocker-SELEX" workflow uses structure-guided virtual screening of a tiny pre-designed pool (1024 ssDNA, 5 nt random) and does not involve a random N-region library with PCR-amplifiable flanking primers. Outside selexprep's primer-inference benchmark scope.

source_attempted: PMC11582725 main text + supp PDF (41698_2024_758_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, 16 pages) inspected via pypdf; supp Table 2 lists template + F/R primers for EGFRapt/MinE07, C36, E3, Waz aptamers
rejection_reason: Paper uses already-known aptamers (EGFRapt/MinE07 and variants of C36/E3/Waz) for in vitro transcription and binding studies. The "primers" in supp Table 2 are aptamer-specific transcription primers (T7 + aptamer 5' / aptamer 3'-tail), NOT library primers flanking a random N region. No SELEX library construction is described. Outside selexprep's primer-inference benchmark scope.
